page.overview:
Who is Wynd and Rayne?

Wynd and Rayne were twin sisters who were servants to Lord Raiden.

These two sisters were servants to the God of Thunder in his home within the high Heavens. Their appearance is that of two tall, beautiful, muscular women with blue and black outfits with Rayne wearing a jacket. They fought against their master's enemies and brought him items that he asked for as well as healing tea. They do not allow uncouth behavior and beat up Kano for his advances on them.
